headline: The SECP said on Saturday it has marked 39,704 companies 'Inactive by Registrar' for failing to file annual returns and/or financial statements for four years, barring them from opening new bank accounts until they file, Business Recorder reports.

card.desc: Filing tak naye bank account nahi khul sakenge.

caption:
39,704 companies inactive qarar!
Business Recorder ke mutabiq SECP ne Saturday ko bataya ke 4 saal se annual returns aur/ya financial statements file na karne wali 39,704 companies ko "Inactive by Registrar" mark kar diya gaya hai. Ye companies overdue documents file kar ke active status wapas lene tak naye bank account nahi khol sakengi. Sab se zyada Lahore (13,927) aur Islamabad (13,859) mein hain.
Kya ye qadam sahi hai? Comment mein batayein 👇
